description: Perl script for generating assembly code for x86 architecture, specifically for NASM syntax, related to OpenSSL/Boringssl cryptography library.

methods.name: ::generic
methods.description: Handles generic assembly instructions, with optimizations for jumps, lea, and clflush.

methods.name: ::call
methods.description: Emits a call instruction, with label decoration.

methods.name: ::call_ptr
methods.description: Emits a call instruction with a pointer.

methods.name: ::jmp_ptr
methods.description: Emits a jump instruction with a pointer.

methods.name: ::get_mem
methods.description: Constructs memory operand strings for assembly instructions.

methods.name: ::DWP
methods.description: Creates a DWORD pointer memory operand.

methods.name: ::file
methods.description: Outputs assembly section directives based on environment.

methods.name: ::function_begin_B
methods.description: Starts a function, setting labels and alignment.

methods.name: ::function_end_B
methods.description: Ends a function, resetting stack and labels.

methods.name: ::file_end
methods.description: Finalizes assembly output, handling specific symbols.

methods.name: ::picmeup
methods.description: Loads address of symbol into destination.

methods.name: ::initseg
methods.description: Initializes code segment, especially for Windows.
